title: Zeta23 — more than two thirds of the zeta zeros are simple and on the critical line
summary: A complete, sorry-free Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the headline theorems of Alpöge–Furman, "More than two thirds of the zeta zeros are simple and on the critical line" (arXiv:2608.13637). Writing N(T) for the number of nontrivial zeros ρ of the Riemann zeta function with 0 1. The statements are made against Mathlib's `riemannZeta` and `DirichletCharacter.LFunction`, with multiplicity via `analyticOrderAt`; nothing is assumed — every analytic input (Weil's explicit formula for ζ and for L(s,χ), the Riemann–von Mangoldt formula, Stirling-type estimates for Γ′/Γ, Chebyshev–Mertens bounds,…
